comment: ERROR BUDGET. A clean document reports nothing; a document with one genuine ERROR node reports it, reports it ONCE, and the walk is capped. `expectErrors` alone cannot pin this: it is a >=1 match, so two copies of ONE error satisfy it. That is the whole reason this channel exists — the pre-fix html analyzer walked for ERROR/MISSING nodes with an UNBOUNDED stack while the engine walked the same tree capped at 50, so a 300-line broken file published 350 warnings for 300 lines. This runner executes the analyzer directly, so the engine's own walk is not in the count here; the analyzer's contribution is what is pinned.
